{{Quote|So what happened? How were we finally stopped?''"<br />"''Your victims and potential victims were too weak to fight back on their own, so they pooled their resources and hired a mercenary army. The army was&hellip; perhaps overly thorough.''"<br />"''And all in the sector rejoiced.''"<br />"''Yes. But for the stopping of a dangerous war machine. Not for the suffering of the innocent.|[[Shada D'ukal]] and [[Jorj Car'das]], on the [[Destruction of Emberlene|destruction]] of [[Emberlene]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
The '''Authala sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Emberlene]] and [[Mordagon]].
